title: Crash investigations with USAF/CIA involvement in Virginia and Brazil

tellings.quote: And then and then it's so that the crashes were then, you know, if if there's US Air Force and CIA involvement which like that they're always seems to be as in the case of Virginia even in Brazil.

plain: Michels says that when craft crash, there always seems to be Air Force and CIA involvement, pointing to cases in Virginia and even in Brazil. He brings this up himself, in passing, without naming a source or describing either case. If true, it would point to a standing pattern of US agencies handling crash sites, even abroad.
